The '''Borundi Peak''' was an inactive [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. It was close to another lone mountain peak, the [[Nicolo Peak]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Imperial Fortress (Yavin 4)|Imperial Fortress]] was built near the foot of the Borundi Peak.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Borundi Peak is one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
